title: Full ML Algo Creator software. Python & PineScript AI Algo Generation.
author: SofexAlgorithms

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: re-running walk-forward on other periods helps, but if the optimizer picked these params out of thousands of candidates, the walk-forward just finds the luckiest survivor one level up. what I'd put on that robustness screen is how many configurations got tried before the one shown, because a good-looking result out of 20 tries and out of 20,000 are very different animals.

replies.author: SofexAlgorithms
replies.body:
You can also test the strategy on completely different markets in the Robustness Lab.

For example a BTCUSD strategy can be tested on ETHUSD, SOLUSD, XRPUSD and soon on Stocks too!

Stocks are coming and the testing on different markets (with reports about return and PF and drawdown not only passed or not) helps a lot!

PS:  
You can see how many algorithms have been tested when you get a new best on the Optimizer screen!

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: ETH, SOL and XRP move with BTC most days, so a strategy passing on all four is closer to one test run four times than four independent checks. stocks will be the real out of sample, different crowd, different hours. a BTC system that survives on gold or a sleepy large cap tells you far more.

replies.author: SofexAlgorithms
replies.body: Gave them as an example. We also have Commodities algos for gold as you said and am now adding the Stocks frontend.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: gold's a decent check for that, most days it doesn't care what crypto did.
